subject: Audit log handback schedule & redaction options for compliance export
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmepay.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@acmepay.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: audit log extract & redaction — upcoming compliance deadline

Sofia,

We're working toward a compliance submission on June 30 and need to confirm how Redwood can deliver audit logs for a quarterly handback. Specifically:

- Can you provide a sample export schema and the delivery options (S3, SFTP, HTTPS transfer)?
- What redaction options do you support at export time (PII removal, pseudonymization, field-level masking)?
- Do you include cryptographic checksums and chain-of-custody metadata with exports?

Can you share the sample schema and a proposed timeline for the export once we sign off?

Thanks,
Lisa Chen
Head of Compliance, Acme Payments
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit log extract & redaction — upcoming compliance deadline

Lisa — thanks for the note. We can support the extraction and have a few standard delivery and redaction patterns. High level: 

- Delivery: S3 (presigned URLs), SFTP push, or encrypted HTTPS POST (multipart). We can also deliver to a cloud bucket in your AWS account.
- Formats: NDJSON (preferred for large volumes), compressed CSV, or Parquet on request. Each export includes a manifest with checksums (SHA256) and a simple audit-of-audit file with export timestamps and requestor identity.
- Redaction options: full PII redaction (drop fields), deterministic pseudonymization (token mapping stored separately), and on-export field masking (hash/truncate). We can also supply a redaction report listing which records were altered.

I've attached a sample export schema (export_schema_v2.csv) and a short explainer on redaction modes (redaction-options.md). Proposed next steps:

1) Confirm preferred delivery mode and schema columns.
2) We schedule a 30-min runbook call to align on retention windows and a signed transport/handback SLA.

Are you available tomorrow 10–11am PT or Thursday 1–2pm PT for a quick sync?

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@acmepay.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmepay.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T12:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit log extract & redaction — upcoming compliance deadline

Thanks, Sofia. Quick clarifications from our side before the call: 

- We prefer S3 delivery into an Acme-managed bucket (cross-account role). Is that supported and can you provide an IAM role template?
- For redaction: deterministic pseudonymization is preferred so we can re-link if needed under legal processes. Does your pseudonymization use per-customer salts or a global key?
- Chain-of-custody: we need signed checksums and an export manifest that includes the job id, initiating user, and UTC timestamps.

If you can confirm those details in the meeting that'd be ideal. We can do Thursday 1–2pm PT.

— Marco
Sr. Compliance Engineer, Acme Payments
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmepay.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@acmepay.com>
Cc: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-01T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit log extract & redaction — upcoming compliance deadline

Marco / Lisa — hi, Marissa here from Product Ops. A few concrete notes ahead of the call: 

- Cross-account S3: supported. We provide an example CloudFormation/IAM policy you can apply; we will push exports using a presigned PUT with an assumed role. We'll bring the template to Thursday's meeting.
- Pseudonymization: we use deterministic pseudonymization with a per-tenant salt that is customer-specific and stored in a KMS-backed secrets store. Keys are rotated per your policy (we can align on rotation cadence). We do not share salts across customers.
- Manifest & chain-of-custody: the manifest includes job_id, initiating principal (email), start/end timestamps (UTC), file checksums (SHA256), record counts, and a signed HMAC using a key unique to the export job. For legal-grade handoff we can optionally notarize manifests via timestamping service — add-on.
- Retention: standard audit logs are retained for 13 months by default; we can extend to 7 years under an enterprise retention contract. Exports can be produced for arbitrary windows.

Attachments I added for the meeting: SLA_handback_matrix.pdf (delivery SLAs and SLAs for large-volume exports).

See you Thursday 1pm PT. Joining details: https://meet.redwood.ai/sofia-acme-export

— Marissa Cole
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmepay.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@acmepay.com>
Cc: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit log extract & redaction — upcoming compliance deadline

Hi Lisa / Marco — legal here. A couple compliance-side items to note before we execute: 

- DPA amendment: since exports create a copy of customer audit data, we require a short DPA amendment to cover handback obligations and retention terms. I've opened a DocuSign and linked it here: https://app.docusign.com/agreements/XYZ-ACME-DPA-AMEND.
- Preservation / legal hold: if you expect to request multiple ad-hoc extracts, let us know so we can prepare a preservation play that avoids accidental pruning during retention windows.
- Tamper evidence: we include checksums in the manifest and keep internal export logs for 365 days for audit. For longer chain-of-custody retention we can set up an immutable S3 prefix under your account.

I'll be on Thursday's call if anything legal-level comes up.

— Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmepay.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@acmepay.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-03T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit log extract & redaction — upcoming compliance deadline

Thanks everyone — that all looks good. We'll review the DocuSign DPA amendment and accept the CloudFormation/IAM template during the meeting. Confirming Thursday 1pm PT — agenda items:

- Finalize export schema (we'll bring a short column wish-list)
- Confirm pseudonymization KMS policy and rotation cadence
- Agree delivery (S3 cross-account) and timeline for initial full-quarter export (target week of June 21)

Appreciate the quick turnaround. See you on Thursday.

— Lisa
Head of Compliance, Acme Payments
